text:
HALVORSEN — Ellery & Vane has acquired the rights to "The Glass Cartographer," according to people familiar with the matter.

The acquisition was confirmed on 14 March 2025 through a signed rights agreement, announced in a joint press statement issued at the Halvorsen Book Fair.

Marguerite Odell, acquisitions director at Ellery & Vane, negotiated the deal, those people said. It covers world English-language rights and carries a reported advance of $425,000.

The joint statement confirmed the agreement but did not elaborate on its terms. The figure was not part of the statement and has been described only by sources close to the negotiations.

Ellery & Vane has not said when the book will be published or in what formats it will appear.

Neither the publisher nor representatives for the title commented beyond the statement.
